dedupe_keys.name: energy and water use municipal buildings

description: The City of Los Angeles publishes benchmarking information for municipal buildings. Fields describe property identity, location, floor area, reporting year, energy intensity, water use, greenhouse-gas emissions and Energy STAR scores where available. Energy intensity is expressed in kBTU per square foot, water in thousand gallons and emissions in metric tonnes of carbon-dioxide equivalent. These building-level benchmarks can support demand estimation and comparisons of simulated building performance. The metadata reports a December 2016 data update and does not establish the complete observation period. No interval consumption profiles, meter-level completeness or present building conditions were checked. Comparable municipal-building datasets from Pittsburgh and Providence refer to other cities and do not establish duplicate identity. Coverage follows the provider-described Los Angeles facilities. Public catalogue pages and JSON metadata are free to access. No licence was stated in the inspected metadata. Data rows and export bodies were not fetched; distribution usability remains unverified. Related city building benchmarks have different geographic coverage.
